checks.claim: P:masked-spectral-growth matches source Proposition 1, with correct constants and a single-pairing proof.
checks.reason: Rederived. J(b)=sqrt(pi/A)exp(-b^2/(4A)) with A=r^2/4 gives (2sqrt(pi)/r)^d exp(-|xi-y|^2/r^2). Applying (16.1) to the single test exp(-r^2|x|^2/4)exp(-iy.x) gives (16.2) with no oscillatory Fubini. Gamma(A/r)=r^(alpha-d)Gamma(A) gives r^(alpha-d)M_Gamma, hence the bound r^alpha M_Gamma/(2sqrt(pi))^d. The lower bound exp(-|xi-y|^2/r^2)>=1/e on open or closed balls gives C_Gamma=eM_Gamma/(2sqrt(pi))^d. M_Gamma>0 uses Gamma != 0.

checks.claim: P:masked-auxiliary-norm matches source Proposition 2, including absolute k_R, the L factor, R-uniform growth and the Hilbert-valued convolution and Schur argument.
checks.reason: k_R(u)=R^d hat zeta(Ru), so ||k_R||_1=L>0. rho_R=c_d^2 L int |k_R(xi-eta)| mu(dxi) agrees with source (4). Evenness follows from k_R(-u)=conj k_R(u) and evenness of mu, with no evenness of zeta assumed. Tonelli with u=xi-eta gives nu_R(B(y,r))=c_d^2 L int |k_R(u)| mu(B(y+u,r))du <= c_d^2 L^2 C_Gamma r^alpha, uniformly in R. No uniform density bound is claimed. Fourier inversion gives hat(zeta_R F)=c_d k_R*hat F. The scalar, finite-rank and projection-limit steps use separable H and Schwartz domination, and the finite-dimensional and zero-space cases are retained. Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz gives the factor c_d^2 L, and Tonelli gives (16.6) exactly.

checks.claim: L:masked-time-completion matches foundation Section 4 and temporal Section 1: positivity, exchanges, Schur bound, separability, complexification and L2 indicator admission.
checks.reason: The Gamma integral identity holds off the diagonal. int_{-inf}^{min(t,s)} 2 lambda e^{-lambda(t-u)}e^{-lambda(s-u)}du = e^{-lambda|t-s|} gives an integral of squares. The row bound sup_t int_0^T|t-s|^(-a)ds <= 2T^(1-a)/(1-a) with 2|xy|<=x^2+y^2 gives (16.7) and justifies the exchanges. L2-dense countable tests give H_a separability. The imaginary cross term cancels by symmetry. The Schur bound on the absolute bilinear form extends the map and the integral formula to L2, which admits bounded measurable amplitudes extended by zero.

checks.claim: P:masked-noise-completion: the (2pi)^d factor, same-W extension, Gaussian limits and finite linear comparison are correct and match the source.
checks.reason: With h(z)=int f(y+z)g(y)dy, h(z)=int e^{i xi z} hat f conj hat g dxi, and int e^{i xi z}h dz=(2pi)^d hat f(-xi)conj hat g(-xi). Applying (16.1) to the single test h and reflecting by evenness gives (16.8) with the correct factor and no conjugation reversal. The temporal sum expands the H_a^C norm. The cutoff admission of D is retained. Proposition 16.2 gives E W(zeta_R F)^2 <= N_R(F)^2 on the same L2(Omega), with null annihilation, Cauchy transfer and uniqueness. Joint Gaussianity of limits uses convergent variances and characteristic functions. The argument b^T A b <= b^T B b, independent Z and conditional Jensen is limited to linear images, and L255-258 disclaims a quotient multiplier and nonlinear comparison.

checks.claim: P:masked-quotient-obstruction: the d=2 Gamma/mu pair, explicit plateau, marginals and positive time factor are correct.
checks.reason: Gamma=delta_0(dx1)dx2 and mu=(2pi)^(-1)dxi1 delta_0(dxi2) are consistent with the convention, since (2pi)^(-1) int e^{i xi1 x1}dxi1=delta_0(x1). Scaling c^1 gives alpha=1<2 and alpha+a<2. The plateau tends to 1 as r->1+ and 0 as r->2-, with infinite-order flatness. V(g)=int(int g dx2)^2dx1 is correct. For g=chi(x1)chi''(x2), the unmasked marginal is zero because int chi''=0. The masked marginal is -I_chi chi(x1)^2, so V(zeta g)=J_chi I_chi^2>0, with J_chi>=2 and I_chi>0. The factor ||tau||_a^2>0 is correct, and no finite C exists. The result is d=2 only, with no d=3 claim.

checks.reason: c'(v)=-A(s+h)conj A(s+h-v)+int A'(u+v)conj A(u)du has the correct sign. c(h)=0, |c|<=hM^2 and |c'|<=M^2+hMD give |f|,|f'|<=K^2. checks.claim: L:masked-trig-products matches temporal Proposition 2, with four correlated modes and no independence.

minor: NOT MANDATORY. Location: TeX L1, L4 and L436-439; PDF pp. 108, 114-115. Evidence: the heading says 'physically masked wave fields', L4 says 'needed for the operator construction', and L438 says 'requires the subsequent arguments'. Why it is not blocking: no statement or status claim asserts these objects, and L257-258 and L437-439 explicitly deny the inference. Clearer wording would say the items remain open and are not established in this section.

NOT MANDATORY. Location: TeX L6-7, 'The zero covariance gives zero in every covariance bound below.' Evidence: this is correct for the Gamma-dependent noise and spectral bounds, but Lemmas 16.3 and 16.6-16.8 are purely temporal and do not vanish when Gamma=0. They hold independently of Gamma, so nothing downstream fails. Restricting the sentence to noise covariance would be more exact.
